SHOT-NEEDS-DEVICE-FRAME.reason: These two files ARE the frame the rule asks for. SafariPhone.tsx draws an iPhone bezel, an iOS status bar and a Safari address bar around every case-study capture; PhoneMockup.tsx is the handset frame used elsewhere. A frame component renders a bare <Image> by definition — that is the one place the rule cannot apply. CaseStudy.tsx came off this list on 2026-09-17 when its interiors stopped being frameless.
